title: 第三三五章 干金鳌第三三四章 旧友
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 玄冥历七百四十年十月初三。
叶辰戴着金乌戒走出苦海。
他才刚刚走出苦海，便感受到了一道如同大日的目光朝着他看来，目光落在他手上的金乌戒之上。
红莲四位真君朝着他奔来，“叶辰，你回来了？”
“怎么样，可曾找到祖师？”
“玄冥前辈怎么不在此处，莫非？”
叶辰道：“祖师已经陨落，临死之前将多宝仙门托付给了我。”
叶辰抬手，亮出自己的金乌戒。
红莲四位真君，看到这金乌戒，顿时明白多宝道君是真的陨落了。
悲伤之际，又追问道：“那玄冥前辈呢，难道玄冥前辈......”
叶辰道：“义父？他自然是去处理这枚戒指带来的后患去了。”
红莲真君不解，“后患，什么后患？”
一只灼热的金色大手从天而降，那恐怖的威压压得方圆千里大地塌陷。
叶辰咬牙撑住，“这便是后患！”
神锤真君抬头，“那是......九阳道君？”
“他一直在等，在等道君的传承出现！”
“这要如何是好？”
道君一掌之下，他们这些金丹初期，金丹中期，根本没有任何反抗之力！
灼热的金色大手之上传出九阳道君威严的声音，“叶辰，交出金乌戒，本座可饶了你的性命！”
叶辰冷笑。
“杀我老祖，破坏多宝长河阵，致使炎荒沦丧，如今还想要强抢元婴传承？”
“九阳老魔，你想要的是不是有些太多了？”
空中传来九阳道君冷峻的声音，“那本座便亲自来取！”
那金色的手掌落下，恐怖的灭世之威荡漾开来。
就在多宝仙门四位真君慌乱不已之时，那金色的手印忽然被截停在了半空中。
地面之上，一座大山接着一座大山裂开了缝隙，如同睁开一只只眼睛一般。
大地颤动，群山凝聚成一座身高千里的巨大法相，千手百眼，遮天蔽日。
其中一只手伸出，稳稳接住了这一道灼热的金色大手。
太一魔君立于千手百眼法相肩膀之上，朗声大笑，喝问道：“九阳老贼，你阴谋击杀多宝，如今还要杀我太一仙门的真君叶辰！”
“你到底意欲何为？”
九阳道君不再遮掩，在空中展露身形。
他身披华服，背后高悬一轮烈日，如同一尊自太阳中走出的神明般降临人世。
“太一！”
“你怎么会在此处？”
“你越界了！”
太一魔君哈哈大笑，“是你杀了多宝算越界，还是本座救自己门下真君算越界？”
content_en:
It is the third day of October in the 740th year of the Xuan Ming Calendar.
Ye Chen walked out of the sea of ​​suffering wearing the Golden Crow Ring.
He had just stepped out of the sea of ​​suffering when he felt a gaze like the sun looking towards him, and it fell on the Golden Crow Ring in his hand.
The four true monarchs of Honglian ran towards him, "Ye Chen, are you back?"
"How is it? Have you found the ancestor?"
"Why isn't Senior Xuanming here? Is it possible?"
Ye Chen said: "The Patriarch has died, and before he died, he entrusted the Duobao Immortal Sect to me."
Ye Chen raised his hand and showed off his Golden Crow Ring.
When the four true monarchs of Honglian saw the Golden Crow Ring, they immediately understood that Taoist Duobao had truly fallen.
When he was sad, he asked again: "What about Senior Xuan Ming? Could it be that Senior Xuan Ming..."
Ye Chen said: "Father? He naturally went to deal with the consequences of this ring."
Lord Honglian was puzzled, "What kind of trouble is there?"
A scorching golden hand fell from the sky, and the terrifying pressure caused the earth within a thousand miles to collapse.
Ye Chen gritted his teeth and held on, "This is the future trouble!"
Lord Divine Hammer raised his head, "Is that... Lord Jiuyang?"
"He has been waiting, waiting for Daojun's inheritance to appear!"
"What should I do?"
Under the palm of Dao Lord, these early-stage and middle-stage Golden Elixirs have no power to resist at all!
The majestic voice of Lord Jiuyang came from the burning golden hand, "Ye Chen, hand over the Golden Crow Ring, and I will spare your life!"
Ye Chen sneered.
"Killed my ancestor, destroyed the Duobao Changhe Formation, and caused the destruction of Yanhuang. Now you want to seize the Nascent Soul inheritance by force?"
"Old Demon Jiuyang, do you want too much?"
The cold voice of Lord Jiuyang came from the air, "Then I will come and get it myself!"
The golden palm fell, and the terrifying power of world destruction rippled out.
Just when the four True Lords of the Duobao Immortal Sect were panicking, the golden handprint was suddenly stopped in mid-air.
On the ground, one mountain after another cracked open, as if opening one eye after another.
The earth trembled, and the mountains condensed into a huge statue thousands of miles tall, with thousands of hands and hundreds of eyes, covering the sky and the sun.
One of the hands stretched out and firmly caught the scorching golden hand.
Taiyi Demon Lord stood on the shoulders of Dharma Prime with Thousand Hands and Hundred Eyes, laughed loudly, and shouted: "Old thief Jiuyang, you conspired to kill Duobao, and now you want to kill Ye Chen, the true king of Taiyi Immortal Sect!"
"What do you want?"
Jiuyang Daojun no longer covered himself up and showed his figure in the air.
Wearing rich clothes, with a scorching sun hanging high behind his back, he descended into the world like a god emerging from the sun.
"Taiyi!"
"Why are you here?"
"You've crossed a line!"
Demon Lord Taiyi laughed loudly, "Would it be considered overstepping the bounds for you to kill Duobao, or would it be overstepping the bounds for me to save the True Lord under my sect?"
